call.en: Tomorrow after five, please. I'm out until late, so leave it with security in Tower B. Or call my wife.
call.vi: Mai sau năm giờ chiều nha em. Chị đi làm về trễ, em gửi bảo vệ tòa B giùm chị, không thì gọi vợ anh.

memo.en: She wants tomorrow before ten, leave it at Tower A reception.
memo.vi: Khách hẹn sáng mai trước mười giờ, gửi lễ tân tòa A.

call.en: Maybe in the afternoon… or tonight, anywhere is fine I guess.
call.vi: Chắc buổi chiều… hoặc tối, để đâu cũng được em.

chat.vi: Em đi công tác tới thứ hai mới về

agent_lines.window_question: Hi {first_name}, your {item} arrives today. Pick at least two windows that work, or tell us you can't receive today.
agent_lines.rescue_chat: We just missed you. When and where should we come back?
agent_lines.call_greeting: Hello, this is the automated delivery assistant calling about your {item}. This call is recorded so we get the delivery right — is that okay?
agent_lines.call_ask: Our courier missed you this morning. Tomorrow we have 8 to 10, 10 to 12, 2 to 5, or 5 to 8 in the evening. Which works for you?
agent_lines.confirm_in_chat: Just to be sure — which works better: {w1} or {w2}?
agent_lines.opt_out_ack: Understood. We won't contact you again about this order.
